economic_thesis: Information and attention can diffuse gradually across native crypto assets. Coherent changes in relative-return rank and persistent relative leadership should continue over a four-day horizon after the common crypto direction is removed.

expected_regime_roles.bear: Long relatively resilient or improving coins and short persistently weak or deteriorating coins after removing the common negative move.
expected_regime_roles.bull: Long persistent relative leaders and short persistent laggards after removing the common positive move.
expected_regime_roles.chop: The level-plus-shift blend and coherence weight should favor sustained cross-sectional leadership over one-bar flips.
expected_regime_roles.long_sleeve: Long the highest persistence ranks: improving or established relative leaders.
expected_regime_roles.short_sleeve: Short the lowest persistence ranks: deteriorating or established relative laggards.
expected_regime_roles.stress: Broad exact-zero-net sleeves, a 0.025 coin cap, and 0.40 maximum gross limit concentration; profitability remains empirical.

falsifier: Reject if the exact no-control reference fails any aggregate, doubled-cost, bull, bear, chop, role, fold, quarter, sleeve, concentration, scheduled-score-coverage, pooled-IC, or fold-IC gate. Controls, neighbors, diagnostics, and private data cannot rescue it.
mechanism: Every 96 hours, convert 96 exact completed 8-hour pure-crypto return cross sections to centered ranks. Positively blend 0.65 times each coin's prior-12 to recent-12 mean-rank shift with 0.35 times its recent-12 mean-rank level, normalize by the preceding 72-rank volatility floor, weight by fixed displacement coherence, then rank and capture the final score before broad equal-dollar zero-net sleeve construction.
risk_policy_plan: Run only the exact disabled no-control reference. No risk control, stop, neighbor, diagnostic, or private ticket activates before every broad PnL gate passes; no later result can repair a failed core.
selection_metric: Every noncompensatory no-control and, after a positive material core, score-evidence gate must pass; no later result substitutes for the exact reference.
